title: Customer Account (Sage)

fields.label: Sage Account Number
fields.name: sage_account_number
fields.instructions: The customer's account reference in Sage 50. Populated automatically by the sync connector.

fields.label: Sage Last Sync
fields.name: sage_last_sync
fields.instructions: Automatically updated by the sync connector. Do not edit manually.

fields.label: Customer Type
fields.name: customer_type
fields.instructions: Used to apply role-based pricing rules and determine available payment methods.

fields.label: Customer Discount Rate (%)
fields.name: customer_discount_rate
fields.instructions: A percentage discount applied across all products at checkout for this customer, on top of tier pricing. Synced from Sage where available. 0 = no discount.

description: Sage 50 account linkage and customer-specific pricing. Shown on the admin user edit screen only. Trimmed 2026-06-10 to the fields the Kryptronic data and Sage integration actually use — pay-on-account, VAT-exemption, and notes fields were removed (zero usage on the old site).
